message.text:
The persistent entity types in the data layer are Attachment, IdentityProvider, Inbox, InstanceSetting, Memo, MemoRelation, MemoShare, Reaction, User, UserIdentity, and UserSetting.

AuthenticationConfig is excluded as a configuration type. The analysis targets Go packages outside the store data layer. A script will scan external .go files for references to each entity type and count distinct importing packages.

The analysis counts unique external package paths that import store types such as `store.Memo` or `*store.User`. These references come from directories like `server`, `internal`, and `cmd`.

message.text:
User is referenced by 7 packages and Memo by 6. Test packages count as external packages. IdentityProvider has zero references, though storepb.IdentityProvider may be used instead.

Checking whether generated storepb types count as data-layer entities. Considering whether to exclude test packages and how to count server/router/api/v1 versus its test subpackage. Visibility, Role, and RowStatus are not entity types.

Excluding test packages leaves User at six references and Memo at five. Generated proto types are not considered data-layer entities.

cmd and internal are being checked for external references. Query types such as FindUser are excluded. IdentityProvider may be used as *store.IdentityProvider in idp_service. InstanceSetting might be referenced as storepb.InstanceSetting.

args.command:
echo '=== store.User packages ==='
grep -rl --include='*.go' 'store\.User\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v '/store/' 
echo
echo '=== store.Memo packages ==='
grep -rl --include='*.go' 'store\.Memo\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v '/store/'
echo
echo '=== store.Attachment ==='
grep -rl --include='*.go' 'store\.Attachment\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v '/store/'
echo
echo '=== store.IdentityProvider ==='
grep -rl --include='*.go' 'store\.IdentityProvider\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v '/store/'
echo
echo '=== storepb entity types outside store ==='
for t in Memo Attachment User Inbox Reaction IdentityProvider InstanceSetting UserSetting; do
  echo -n "storepb.$t: "
  grep -rl --include='*.go' "storepb\.$t\b" /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v '/store/' | sed 's|/[^/]*\.go$||' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
  echo
done
echo
echo '=== cmd/internal store. refs ==='
grep -rn --include='*.go' 'store\.\(User\|Memo\|Attachment\|Inbox\|Reaction\)\b' /bench/repo/cmd /bench/repo/internal 2>/dev/null | head
